scope: Before-reserve cancellation retains latent identity without allocating Person/Participant/Session/Channels.
Real accepted invite/open-channel barriers precede original Native pending cancellation; independent cleanup entry waits for the held actual invitation to drain before producing its terminal result.

Unknown Channel admission reads and accepted-close/no-receipt failures retain preparing Person, original identity/capacity, maintenance and no result. First cold process repeats actual unknown admission and refuses original cleanup without append/inference; second cold process uses the same canonical owner and real terminal evidence before abandonment/result/wake.
Commit-winning cancellation is already-committed; ready identity, represents, original inventory and result remain preserved.

SIGKILL after accepted Channel IO/pending cancellation and immediately before/after the actual Native abandonment append replays the same identities, cleanup evidence, result and exactly one pending requester notification.

priorStage.distinction: Old stage warmed unknown IO to terminal before cold restores. It is frozen separately and is not used as pending-cold evidence.

deferred: X12 remains incomplete: shared-contact cancellation/unknown IO and complete request/rule-sampling persistence fault boundaries are outside this representative fixture.
It does not substitute absence for arbitrary provider read failures or automatically resume a restored run.
